verdict: Lead volume is low; launch gaps and pipeline conversion are being addressed now.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 29 leads at a cost of $145.09 per lead — a quiet period, and below where this program should be performing. The core issue is not ad performance: several planned launch milestones from late July and early August remain unconfirmed as complete, which has limited the full campaign from running as designed. Google Ads recorded only 5 conversions against $2,823.90 in spend; conversion tracking is being repaired, so that number under-reports true activity. Separately, 127 pipeline opportunities were created in the last 28 days with 0 appointments and 0 won — we are reviewing the intake process to ensure leads are being followed up promptly. Resolving the launch items and intake flow are the two actions in motion now; you should expect clearer lead numbers and improved pipeline movement once both are confirmed.
